name: Erlking
description: A malevolent fairy-king of Germanic Romanticism, derived via Herder's 1778 mistranslation from the Danish 'ellekonge' ('king of the elves'); famously portrayed in Goethe's 1782 ballad 'Erlkönig' as a supernatural being who lures a child to its death, set to music by Franz Schubert (D. 328, 1815).

aliases.name: Ellekonge
aliases.meaning: 'King of the elves'; the original Scandinavian root

aliases.name: The Erl-King
aliases.meaning: Standard English rendering, popularized through Goethe and Schubert

origin: Originating in Danish ballad tradition and codified in late-18th-century German literature; spread globally through Goethe's poem and Schubert's lied.
